comment: UNENFORCED legacy scaffold (Phase 0 workstream E). The LIVE fallback authority is now WG-11(b) family-aware routing in scripts/hooks/lib/providers.js (suggestFallbackProvider + PROVIDER_FAMILY) — a quota/outage fallback lands in a DIFFERENT model family, never same-family. This file's per-role policies below still carry PRE-ADR-0007 role keys (redteam/reviewer/compliance/qa) and PRE-DISPATCH.md-§8 model ids (gpt-5.5, claude-sonnet-4-6, gemini-3.1-pro-preview); they are documentation only and no consumer routes off them. A full rewrite to the new roster (security-reviewer/frontend-reviewer/qa-reviewer + gpt-5.6/sonnet-5/antigravity) is deferred with the ADR-0007 scaffold-cleanup, out of the SP-20260716-001 flip scope. Do not treat the ids below as authoritative.

redteam.rationale: redteam runs adversarial-corpus reasoning; gemini-3.1-pro-preview is the primary (operator directive 2026-06-01 — thinking always-on, 1M context, ideal for attack-chain reasoning). It is a PREVIEW tier (v1beta) and can quota-fail / silently downgrade under load, so the first fallback is gemini-3.5-flash — the GA (v1) promotion of the 3.x Flash line: newer than 2.5, no preview fragility, same adversarial-corpus diversity (β DECIDE 2026-06-01, conf 0.87). gemini-2.5-flash is retained as deep_fallback — a prior-gen but rock-solid known-good safety net. A total gemini outage falls through runProvider's provider-level fallback:claude. A SECOND security pass ALWAYS runs on openai:gpt-5.5 (dispatch-agent --provider openai) so security covers two model families and survives even that. Override the primary anytime with GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.5-flash (or gemini-2.5-flash).

reviewer.rationale: GPT-5.5 xhigh is the diversity lens against Claude builders. Falling back to claude-sonnet-4-6 keeps gauntlets moving when codex is unreachable.

qa.rationale: qa runs 13 personas — cost-balanced primary. Haiku fallback keeps per-persona cost predictable on outages.

notes: auth_source_mismatch deliberately does NOT auto-fall-back. The user has set both API key AND OAuth — failing closed surfaces the configuration ambiguity rather than silently using the wrong account.
